items.title: Seafood & Fisheries
items.summary: Frozen and chilled seafood shipments depend on equipment readiness, temperature instructions, port timing and careful handovers. Our reefer experience helps frame the questions that matter before a container is loaded, from transport planning to routing and export documentation.

items.title: Agriculture & Fresh Produce
items.summary: Fresh produce moves against maturity, shelf-life and buyer receiving windows. Logistics planning must account for packing, temperature and ventilation requirements, inspection procedures, routing choices and the time cargo spends between controlled environments.

items.title: Food & Beverage
items.summary: Food ingredients, processed products, frozen foods and shelf-stable packaged goods have different handling needs. We coordinate shipment options around packaging, condition, documentation and the delivery schedule required by the buyer.

items.title: Pharmaceuticals & Healthcare
items.summary: Healthcare shipments place exceptional importance on product classification, documentation, handling instructions and shipment visibility. Where suitable specialist arrangements are available, logistics can be planned around validated shipper requirements, handling controls and applicable regulations.

items.title: Automotive & Auto Components
items.summary: Vehicle parts and manufacturing components often serve production schedules that cannot tolerate avoidable uncertainty. We help coordinate container options, packing requirements, import/export documents and departure timing around the customer's supply plan.

items.title: Industrial Machinery & Equipment
items.summary: Machinery shipments require accurate weights, dimensions, lifting and packing information before a transport plan can be finalised. Standard container options may work for some cargo; others need specialised equipment and partner assessment.

items.title: Chemicals & Petrochemicals
items.summary: Chemical movements begin with correct product identification and regulatory classification. Documentation, packaging, carrier acceptance and permitted equipment must be established before a shipment is confirmed. Hazardous shipments are subject to licensed, carrier-approved handling arrangements.

items.title: Electronics & Technology
items.summary: Electronic and electrical cargo can be sensitive to shock, moisture, theft and delivery schedules. Freight planning should reflect packaging, value, handling instructions, transit options and the customer's destination requirements.

items.title: Textiles & Apparel
items.summary: Apparel and fabric supply chains balance seasonal deadlines, multiple suppliers and buyer-specific documentation. FCL and LCL options can be planned around origin consolidation, cutoffs and consignee receiving arrangements.

items.title: Metals, Minerals & Steel
items.summary: Weight, loading limits, packaging and cargo securing often determine transport feasibility for metal products and industrial raw materials. The right container and inland equipment matter as much as the ocean route.

items.title: Plastics, Polymers & Packaging
items.summary: Packaging materials, resins and finished plastic products move across industrial supply chains with varying volume and protection needs. We evaluate equipment, packing declarations, documentation and delivery timing for the specific product.

items.title: Paper, Pulp & Forest Products
items.summary: Moisture protection, weight distribution, product condition and destination documentation matter for paper and forest-derived goods. Appropriate packing and routing decisions help protect the shipment through each leg.

items.title: Project Cargo & Heavy Engineering
items.summary: The first requirement of project cargo is a workable movement plan. Out-of-gauge dimensions, weights, lifting, lashing, survey needs, route restrictions and site readiness influence options long before a vessel is booked. Specialist service delivery is arranged subject to feasibility and approvals.

items.title: Construction & Infrastructure
items.summary: Building materials, fabricated components and site equipment must arrive in step with construction programmes. We coordinate the transportation and documentation elements appropriate to the cargo, equipment and delivery location.

items.title: Renewable Energy & Power
items.summary: Power equipment and renewable-energy components may combine delicate handling with oversized dimensions. Shipping plans need to evaluate packaging, securing, multimodal requirements and the project timeline.

items.title: Oil, Gas & Energy Equipment
items.summary: Equipment for energy operations often has demanding specifications, special handling constraints and tightly planned receiving windows. We can assess shipment requirements and coordinate suitable logistics arrangements where available and authorised.

items.title: Retail & Consumer Goods
items.summary: Retail supply chains can bring together many SKUs, suppliers, purchase orders and delivery dates. Our role is to help align cargo booking and documents with the receiving requirements of the business.

items.title: General Cargo & Multisector Trade
items.summary: Standard containerised shipments still require the same operational discipline as specialised cargo. From booking and paperwork to port handover and inland movement, we coordinate the elements that make a cargo movement workable.
